# User mode reset on navigation stop (2026-02-06 16:10Z)

_**User**_

when the navigation is stopped automatically or by the user, the modes the user is currently in should reset/revert.

This means:

When the user is in double-tap mode this mode should be disabled.
When the user is in single-tap mode this mode should be disabled.

If auto-route updates are enabled\n        // and the user is off-route, we refresh the route, preferring cache.\n        stopAutoUpdate()\n        let interval = Double(settings.mapUpdateInterval)\n        guard interval &gt; 0 else { return }\n        timerCancellable = Timer.publish(every: interval, on: .main, in: .common)\n            .autoconnect()\n            .sink { _ in\n                Task {\n                    await fetchTargetDeviceLocation(resetAndRecenter: false)\n                    if !hasLocationUpdateSinceLastAutoUpdate {\n                        checkAutoStopCondition()\n                        return\n                    }\n                    hasLocationUpdateSinceLastAutoUpdate = false\n                    if isAutoRouteUpdateLocked &amp;&amp; isUserOffRoute(threshold: offRouteThreshold) {\n                        if !useCachedRouteIfValid() {\n                            calculateRoute()\n                        }\n                    }\n                    // Check if devices are close enough to auto-stop navigation\n                    checkAutoStopCondition()\n                }\n            }\n    }\n\n    private func isUserOffRoute(threshold: CLLocationDistance? = nil) -&gt; Bool {\n        guard let route, let user = userCoordinate else { return false }",

        "contents": "    }\n\n    private func isUserOffRoute(threshold: CLLocationDistance? = nil) -&gt; Bool {\n        guard let route, let user = userCoordinate else { return false }\n        let limit = threshold ?? offRouteThreshold\n        let polyline = route.polyline\n        guard polyline.pointCount &gt; 1 else { return false }\n\n        let userPoint = MKMapPoint(user)\n        let points = polyline.points()\n        var minDistance = CLLocationDistance.greatestFiniteMagnitude\n\n        for index in 0..&lt;(polyline.pointCount - 1) {\n            let distance = distanceFromPoint(userPoint, toSegmentStart: points[index], end: points[index + 1])\n            minDistance = min(minDistance, distance)\n            if minDistance &lt;= limit {\n                return false\n            }\n        }\n        return minDistance &gt; limit\n    }\n\n    private func distanceFromPoint(_ point: MKMapPoint, toSegmentStart start: MKMapPoint, end: MKMapPoint) -&gt; CLLocationDistance {\n        let dx = end.x - start.x\n        let dy = end.y - start.y\n        if dx == 0 &amp;&amp; dy == 0 {\n            return point.distance(to: start)\n        }\n        let t = ((point.x - start.x) * dx + (point.y - start.y) * dy) / (dx * dx + dy * dy)\n        let clamped = max(0, min(1, t))\n        let projection = MKMapPoint(x: start.x + clamped * dx, y: start.y + clamped * dy)\n        return point.distance(to: projection)\n    }\n\n    private func stopAutoUpdate() {\n        timerCancellable?.cancel()\n        timerCancellable = nil\n    }\n\n    private func restartAutoUpdate() {\n        startAutoUpdate()\n    }\n\n    // Removed: restartTimeUpdateTimer(). Color.green : Color.primary)\n                .symbolEffect(.rotate.clockwise.byLayer, options: .nonRepeating, isActive: isUpdating)\n                .padding(.horizontal, 6)\n                .padding(.vertical, 8)\n                .contentShape(Rectangle())\n                .onTapGesture {\n                    if animationsAllowed {\n                        withAnimation { isUpdating = true }\n                    } else {\n                        isUpdating = true\n                    }\n                    Task {\n                        await fetchTargetDeviceLocation(resetAndRecenter: true, ignoreRouteCache: true)\n                        if animationsAllowed {\n                            withAnimation { isUpdating = false }\n                        } else {\n                            isUpdating = false\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                .onLongPressGesture(minimumDuration: 0.6) {\n                    // Toggle global setting for automatic route updates while navigating\n                    settings.automaticRouteUpdateDuringNavigation.toggle()\n                    isAutoRouteUpdateLocked = settings.automaticRouteUpdateDuringNavigation\n                    if settings.automaticRouteUpdateDuringNavigation {\n                        Haptic.notifySuccess()\n                        calculateRoute()\n                    } else {\n                        Haptic.notifyWarning()\n                    }\n                }\n                .accessibilityLabel(Text(NSLocalizedString(\"reload\", comment: \"Reload target device location\")))\n                .accessibilityHint(Text(NSLocalizedString(\"reload_longpress_hint\", comment: \"Long-press to toggle automatic route updates.\")))\n        }\n        .animation(animationsAllowed ? .easeInOut(duration: 0.2) : nil, value: isAutoRouteUpdateLocked)\n        .accessibilityAddTraits(.isButton)\n    }",

100m; applies a daily network request limit.\n        guard let user = userCoordinate, let device = deviceCoordinate else { return }\n        if retryAttempt == 0 {\n            routeRetryTask?.cancel()\n            routeRetryTask = nil\n            pendingRouteRetryOnReconnect = false\n        }\n        // Try to reuse cached route first unless explicitly told to ignore cache\n        if !ignoreCache {\n            if useCachedRouteIfValid() { return }\n            // Only recalc when one of the positions changed since the last route calculation (or if there's no route yet)\n            let userTimestampChanged = userTimestamp != lastRouteUserTimestamp\n            let deviceTimestampChanged = deviceTimestamp != lastRouteDeviceTimestamp\n            var userCoordinatesChanged = true\n            if let lastUser = lastRouteUserCoordinate {\n                userCoordinatesChanged = (lastUser.latitude != user.latitude) || (lastUser.longitude != user.longitude)\n            }\n            var deviceCoordinatesChanged = true\n            if let lastDevice = lastRouteDeviceCoordinate {\n                deviceCoordinatesChanged = (lastDevice.latitude != device.latitude) || (lastDevice.longitude != device.longitude)\n            }\n            let transportTypeChanged = settings.navigationTransportType != lastRouteTransportType\n            let shouldRecalculate = (route == nil) || userTimestampChanged || deviceTimestampChanged || userCoordinatesChanged || deviceCoordinatesChanged || transportTypeChanged\n            if !shouldRecalculate { return }\n        }\n\n        // Enforce daily limit through centralized counter with calendar-day reset\n        routeCounter.checkAndResetIfNeeded()\n        guard routeCounter.count &lt; routeRequestDailyLimit else {\n            showErrorOverlay(\n                \"Daily route request limit reached\",",

        "contents": "    private func enableNavigationMode() {\n        isNavigationMode = true\n        isAutoCenteringEnabled = true\n        lastFollowCameraUpdate = nil\n        lastFollowCameraCenter = nil\n        lastFollowCameraHeading = nil\n        followCameraDistanceOverride = nil\n        isFollowAutoZoomEnabled = true\n        if let routeRegion = regionThatFitsRoute() {\n            isProgrammaticCameraChange = true\n            if animationsAllowed {\n                withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.35)) {\n                    mapPosition = .region(routeRegion)\n                }\n            } else {\n                mapPosition = .region(routeRegion)\n            }\n            shouldPerformInitialNavigationZoom = true\n            Task {\n                try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 2_500_000_000)\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    if shouldPerformInitialNavigationZoom &amp;&amp; isNavigationMode {\n                        performInitialNavigationZoom()\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            shouldPerformInitialNavigationZoom = false\n            updateFollowCamera(animated: true, force: true)\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func disableNavigationMode() {\n        isNavigationMode = false\n        isAutoCenteringEnabled = true\n        lastFollowCameraUpdate = nil\n        lastFollowCameraCenter = nil\n        lastFollowCameraHeading = nil\n        followCameraDistanceOverride = nil\n        isFollowAutoZoomEnabled = true\n        shouldPerformInitialNavigationZoom = false\n        resetZoomToFitRouteOrBoth()\n    }\n\n    private func updateFollowCamera(animated: Bool, force: Bool = false) {\n        guard !shouldPerformInitialNavigationZoom else { return }",

        "contents": "    private func updateTrackingMode() {\n        let state = UIApplication.shared.applicationState\n        let status = locationManager.authorizationStatus\n        debugLog(\"updateTrackingMode called, state: \\(state.rawValue), status: \\(status.rawValue), isTracking: \\(isTracking)\")\n        switch status {\n        case .authorizedAlways, .authorizedWhenInUse:\n            if isTracking {\n                if state == .active {\n                    startHighAccuracyUpdates()\n                } else {\n                    startSignificantChangeUpdates()\n                }\n            } else {\n                // Ensure updates are stopped but preserve user's tracking preference flag\n                stopHighAccuracyUpdates()\n                stopSignificantChangeUpdates()\n            }\n        case .notDetermined:\n            // Do not reset isTracking while the user has not decided yet\n            break\n        case .denied, .restricted:\n            // Explicitly stop tracking if permission is denied/restricted\n            stopTracking()\n            // Update the setting to reflect the actual permission state\n            if settings.trackAndReportLocation {\n                settings.trackAndReportLocation = false\n            }\n        @unknown default:\n            stopHighAccuracyUpdates()\n            stopSignificantChangeUpdates()\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func startHighAccuracyUpdates() {\n        debugLog(\"Calling startHighAccuracyUpdates\")",

Deferring slightly ensures the deep link wins over restoration.\n            await Task.yield()\n            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 180_000_000)\n\n            // If the device already exists, navigate to it; otherwise fall back to add flow.\n            if KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }) {\n                showAddDeviceSheet = false\n                pendingDeviceID = nil\n                SettingsManager.shared.lastOpenedDeviceID = deviceID\n            } else {\n                pendingDeviceID = deviceID\n                showAddDeviceSheet = true\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nprivate struct DeviceWindowEntrypoint: View {\n    @Binding var deviceID: String?\n    @Environment(\\.openWindow) private var openWindow",

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>

Looking at the code, I can see:

1. **Navigation stopping**: There are two places where navigation stops:
   - `checkAutoStopCondition()` - automatically stops navigation when devices are close (line 1444-1477)
   - `stopNavigation()` - called when navigation is stopped (line 1479-1491)

2. **Modes**:
   - `isNavigationMode` - navigation mode (double-tap mode when `isRouteReversed` is true)
   - `isFollowDeviceHeadingMode` - single-tap mode (when `isRouteReversed` is false)

3. **Mode enabling/disabling**:
   - `enableNavigationMode()` / `disableNavigationMode()` - for navigation mode
   - `enableFollowDeviceHeadingMode()` / `disableFollowDeviceHeadingMode()` - for follow device heading mode

4. **Where navigation stops**:
   - `checkAutoStopCondition()` calls `stopNavigation()` when devices are close
   - `stopNavigation()` clears route and navigation info but doesn't disable the modes

I need to:
1. Add code to `stopNavigation()` to disable both modes
2. Check if there are other places where navigation is stopped manually by the user

Let me search for where the user might manually stop navigation.
</details></think>

        "contents": "        ZStack(alignment: .topTrailing) {\n            Image(systemName: \"arrow.clockwise\")\n                .foregroundStyle(isAutoRouteUpdateLocked ? Color.green : Color.primary)\n                .symbolEffect(.rotate.clockwise.byLayer, options: .nonRepeating, isActive: isUpdating)\n                .padding(.horizontal, 6)\n                .padding(.vertical, 8)\n                .contentShape(Rectangle())\n                .onTapGesture {\n                    if animationsAllowed {\n                        withAnimation { isUpdating = true }\n                    } else {\n                        isUpdating = true\n                    }\n                    Task {\n                        await fetchTargetDeviceLocation(resetAndRecenter: true, ignoreRouteCache: true)\n                        if animationsAllowed {\n                            withAnimation { isUpdating = false }\n                        } else {\n                            isUpdating = false\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                .onLongPressGesture(minimumDuration: 0.6) {\n                    // Toggle global setting for automatic route updates while navigating\n                    settings.automaticRouteUpdateDuringNavigation.toggle()\n                    isAutoRouteUpdateLocked = settings.automaticRouteUpdateDuringNavigation\n                    if settings.automaticRouteUpdateDuringNavigation {\n                        Haptic.notifySuccess()\n                        calculateRoute()\n                    } else {\n                        Haptic.notifyWarning()\n                    }\n                }\n                .accessibilityLabel(Text(NSLocalizedString(\"reload\", comment: \"Reload target device location\")))\n                .accessibilityHint(Text(NSLocalizedString(\"reload_longpress_hint\", comment: \"Long-press to toggle automatic route updates.\")))\n        }\n        .animation(animationsAllowed ? .easeInOut(duration: 0.2) : nil, value: isAutoRouteUpdateLocked)\n        .accessibilityAddTraits(.isButton)\n    }",

        "contents": "    private func recordInitialDistance() {\n        // Record the initial distance between devices when navigation starts\n        // This is used to determine if auto-stop should be enabled\n        guard let user = userCoordinate, let device = deviceCoordinate else { return }\n        let userLocation = CLLocation(latitude: user.latitude, longitude: user.longitude)\n        let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)\n        let distance = userLocation.distance(from: deviceLocation)\n        if initialDistance == nil {\n            initialDistance = distance\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func checkAutoStopCondition() {\n        // Automatically stop navigation if devices are within 50m of each other,\n        // but only if they weren't already within 50m when navigation started\n        // Skip check if navigation has already been stopped\n        guard !navigationStopped else { return }\n        guard let user = userCoordinate, let device = deviceCoordinate else { return }\n        guard let initialDist = initialDistance else {\n            // If initial distance hasn't been recorded yet, record it now\n            recordInitialDistance()\n            return\n        }\n        \n        let userLocation = CLLocation(latitude: user.latitude, longitude: user.longitude)\n        let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)\n        let currentDistance = userLocation.distance(from: deviceLocation)\n        \n        // Only auto-stop if:\n        // 1.         "contents": "    private func calculateRoute(ignoreCache: Bool = false, retryAttempt: Int = 0) {\n        // Calculate a new route between user and selected device.\n        // Prefers a cached route when movement &lt; 100m; applies a daily network request limit.\n        guard let user = userCoordinate, let device = deviceCoordinate else { return }\n        if retryAttempt == 0 {\n            routeRetryTask?.cancel()\n            routeRetryTask = nil\n            pendingRouteRetryOnReconnect = false\n        }\n        // Try to reuse cached route first unless explicitly told to ignore cache\n        if !ignoreCache {\n            if useCachedRouteIfValid() { return }\n            // Only recalc when one of the positions changed since the last route calculation (or if there's no route yet)\n            let userTimestampChanged = userTimestamp != lastRouteUserTimestamp\n            let deviceTimestampChanged = deviceTimestamp != lastRouteDeviceTimestamp\n            var userCoordinatesChanged = true\n            if let lastUser = lastRouteUserCoordinate {\n                userCoordinatesChanged = (lastUser.latitude != user.latitude) || (lastUser.longitude != user.longitude)\n            }\n            var deviceCoordinatesChanged = true\n            if let lastDevice = lastRouteDeviceCoordinate {\n                deviceCoordinatesChanged = (lastDevice.latitude != device.latitude) || (lastDevice.longitude != device.longitude)\n            }\n            let transportTypeChanged = settings.navigationTransportType != lastRouteTransportType\n            let shouldRecalculate = (route == nil) || userTimestampChanged || deviceTimestampChanged || userCoordinatesChanged || deviceCoordinatesChanged || transportTypeChanged\n            if !shouldRecalculate { return }\n        }\n\n        // Enforce daily limit through centralized counter with calendar-day reset\n        routeCounter.checkAndResetIfNeeded()\n        guard routeCounter.count &lt; routeRequestDailyLimit else {\n            showErrorOverlay(\n                \"Daily route request limit reached\",",

        "contents": "    private func enableNavigationMode() {\n        isNavigationMode = true\n        isAutoCenteringEnabled = true\n        lastFollowCameraUpdate = nil\n        lastFollowCameraCenter = nil\n        lastFollowCameraHeading = nil\n        followCameraDistanceOverride = nil\n        isFollowAutoZoomEnabled = true\n        if let routeRegion = regionThatFitsRoute() {\n            isProgrammaticCameraChange = true\n            if animationsAllowed {\n                withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.35)) {\n                    mapPosition = .region(routeRegion)\n                }\n            } else {\n                mapPosition = .region(routeRegion)\n            }\n            shouldPerformInitialNavigationZoom = true\n            Task {\n                try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 2_500_000_000)\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    if shouldPerformInitialNavigationZoom &amp;&amp; isNavigationMode {\n                        performInitialNavigationZoom()\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            shouldPerformInitialNavigationZoom = false\n            updateFollowCamera(animated: true, force: true)\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func disableNavigationMode() {\n        isNavigationMode = false\n        isAutoCenteringEnabled = true\n        lastFollowCameraUpdate = nil\n        lastFollowCameraCenter = nil\n        lastFollowCameraHeading = nil\n        followCameraDistanceOverride = nil\n        isFollowAutoZoomEnabled = true\n        shouldPerformInitialNavigationZoom = false\n        resetZoomToFitRouteOrBoth()\n    }\n\n    private func updateFollowCamera(animated: Bool, force: Bool = false) {\n        guard !shouldPerformInitialNavigationZoom else { return }",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/navigation_overlay_mode_a06f0fbb.plan.md",

        "contents": "---\nname: Navigation Overlay Mode\noverview: Add NavigationOverlayKit to show turn-by-turn instructions when navigation is switched to “from current device → other device”, updating the overlay in sync with route recalculation and live location updates, and document the change.\ntodos:\n  - id: overlay-wireup\n    content: Wire overlay view/model into iPhone_DeviceNavigationView\n    status: completed\n  - id: sync-updates\n    content: Update overlay on route and location changes\n    status: completed\n  - id: docs-changelog\n    content: Update CHANGELOG and feature docs\n    status: completed\nisProject: false\n---\n\n## Implementation plan\n\n### 1) Wire the overlay into the navigation view\n\n- In &#96;iPhone_DeviceNavigationView&#96; add a &#96;NavigationOverlayViewModel&#96; state object and create/update it when a route is calculated and the mode is “current device → other device” (&#96;isRouteReversed == false&#96;).\n- Place the overlay at the top of the map overlay stack in &#96;mapWithModifiers&#96; so it appears above the map but below other system overlays. This lines up with the existing overlay structure and your UI preference.\n- Ensure the overlay is hidden when:\n  - &#96;isRouteReversed == true&#96; (device → user mode)\n  - &#96;route == nil&#96; (no route)\n  - Navigation has been auto-stopped (route cleared)\n\n### 2) Keep instructions in sync with live location\n\n- On each location update (&#96;locationManager.$currentLocation&#96;) update the overlay view model’s current step based on the user’s position on the route.\n- When the route is recalculated (manual reload, auto-update, or transport type change), reset the overlay view model with the new &#96;MKRoute&#96; and restart at step 0.\n- If the route is swapped via the toolbar button, recreate the overlay view model only when switching to &#96;isRouteReversed == false&#96;.\n\n### 3) Handle edge cases and side effects\n\n- Ensure that cached routes still populate the overlay view model when the cached route is applied, not only when a new network route is fetched.\n- When &#96;stopNavigation()&#96; clears the route, also clear/hide the overlay to avoid stale instructions.\n- Confirm the overlay responds correctly to &#96;mapUpdateInterval&#96; auto-updates and to mutual navigation changes (no changes required, but verify no overlay conflicts).",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

## Summary

Updated `stopNavigation()` to disable both navigation modes when navigation stops (automatically or manually).

**Changes made:**
- Disabled `isNavigationMode` (double-tap mode when route is reversed)
- Disabled `isFollowDeviceHeadingMode` (single-tap mode when route is not reversed)
- Reset related state variables (`shouldPerformInitialNavigationZoom`, follow camera state, etc.)

**When this applies:**
- Automatic stop: when devices are within 50m of each other (`checkAutoStopCondition()` calls `stopNavigation()`)
- Manual stop: when the user cancels navigation (the view is dismissed, so modes reset)

Both modes are now disabled when navigation stops, ensuring a clean reset regardless of which mode was active.

Summary of what was committed:

**Commit:** `3535359c` — *Reset navigation modes when navigation is stopped*

**Description:**  
When navigation stops (either automatically because devices are within 50 m, or when the user stops it), the view now resets all navigation-related modes and state:

- **Double-tap mode** (`isNavigationMode`) is turned off so the map is no longer in turn-by-turn navigation.
- **Single-tap mode** (`isFollowDeviceHeadingMode`) is turned off so the map no longer follows the device heading.
- Follow-camera and auto-centering state are cleared (`lastFollowCameraUpdate`, `lastFollowCameraCenter`, `lastFollowCameraHeading`, `followCameraDistanceOverride`, `isFollowAutoZoomEnabled`, `isAutoCenteringEnabled`, `shouldPerformInitialNavigationZoom`).

This is done inside `stopNavigation()`, which runs for both automatic and manual stop, so the map always returns to a neutral state after navigation ends.
